data_currency_finding_2026_10_26.summary: Every provincial and territorial CRA charities builder reads the CRA dataset 51c68b86-33f0-46fe-9b51-0a786d0088f5, which is "1998 List of charities", not the current registry. The app presents these documents as the latest official registry listing.

evidence.package_title: 1998 List of charities (Liste des organismes de bienfaisance 1998)
evidence.newer_lists_exist: Separate datasets for every year 1990-2024 (e.g. "2024 List of charities", modified 2026-10-04).
evidence.builder_selection: The Identification CSV of that package, province filter, then the FIRST 100 rows in the file's own order (slice(0, 100)); not a ranking and not alphabetical. 111 Yukon rows, 100 stored, 11 omitted by file order; 76 distinct names among the 100 stored.
evidence.ui_wording: The registry card says "Latest official tax-exempt registry listing" and "Top listing from N in official source"; neither is accurate for this selection.
evidence.affected_documents: subnational_tax_exempt_entities for ON, BC, AB, QC, SK, MB, NS, NB, NL, PE (written earlier) and YT (2026-10-26); NT and NU not yet written.
evidence.certainty: Strong (dataset title, coverage dates, FPE values). Not cross-checked against the live CRA registry.

meaning_of_zero_values.stored: rawValue: 0 on every record; no fmtValue.
meaning_of_zero_values.source_mapping: The Identification CSV has only BN, Category, Designation, Legal Name, Account Name, address, province, postal code, country, contact, phone, email, website. It carries no financial columns, so the builder sets rawValue 0 as a placeholder (see the "No dollar values in this version" note on the document).
meaning_of_zero_values.interpretation: 0 means "financial data not stored", NOT zero revenue, assets or donations. The same CRA dataset family does publish financial data ("Financial data and general information" CSV, per year), which the builders do not use.
meaning_of_zero_values.risk_in_app: normalizeTaxExemptRow turns a missing or 0 amount into rawValue 0 and fmtValue "$0". The app's isCraCharitiesDataset() detection (verified: true for the Yukon document by data_source text and by the all-zero structural fallback) is what suppresses dollar display, and the registry headline omits "Largest reported value" when every value is 0. Display on the live page has not been verified yet. Any other consumer of the Firestore document would read 0 as a real value.

recommended_correction: 1. Data contract: stop storing 0 for unavailable money. Omit rawValue (or store null) on charity records and add a document-level flag such as financials: "not_published_in_this_extract". Update normalizeTaxExemptRow so a missing amount is never formatted as "$0" (UI change, needs approval).

2. Source: decide between (a) switching the builders to the most recent CRA "List of charities" dataset (discover the newest programmatically and label the fiscal year on the card), optionally mapping real financial fields from that year's Financial data CSV (needs a field-mapping and display decision), or (b) keeping the 1998 list but labelling it honestly as a 1998 listing. Option (a) is recommended.

3. Selection and wording: "first 100 in file order" is not a "top" list. Either rank by a real measure once financials exist, or sort alphabetically, and change the wording to "Showing N of M registered charities".

4. Rewrite plan: re-write the 11 existing charity documents through a guarded, backed-up script (merge replaces the records array); hold the NT and NU charities writes until the source decision is made.
